assets.externalization_strategy: Move bulky public datasets to documented external storage or dataset download scripts after owner review; keep only manifests, checksums, and small reproducible samples in Git.
assets.demo_boundary: Use summarized dataset provenance and small synthetic/public-safe samples during defense; do not open large raw files live.
assets.acceptance_rule: No deletion until dataset source, regeneration path, and sample replacement are documented.

assets.externalization_strategy: Classify processed tables as reproducible outputs or canonical evaluation fixtures; externalize bulky reproducible outputs after ETL command and checksum are recorded.
assets.demo_boundary: Show aggregate metrics and schema examples, not full processed tables.
assets.acceptance_rule: Keep files required by tests or thesis metrics until replacement fixtures are validated.

assets.externalization_strategy: Store large model weights in release assets or external model storage with version, dependency baseline, checksum, and re-export command.
assets.demo_boundary: Show model cards, metrics, and compatibility evidence instead of raw binary files.
assets.acceptance_rule: Do not delete model artifacts needed for smoke tests, compatibility checks, or thesis reproduction.

assets.externalization_strategy: Keep authoritative medical PDFs under a documented source list; externalize only if retrieval rebuild scripts and checksums are available.
assets.demo_boundary: Show document titles, source provenance, and retrieval evidence; avoid scrolling huge PDFs during live demo.
assets.acceptance_rule: RAG source PDFs remain protected assets because they define knowledge-base provenance.
examples: backend/rag/docs/成人高尿酸血症与痛风食养指南_2024.pdf
backend/rag/docs/慢性肾脏病早期筛查_诊断及防治指南_2022.pdf
backend/rag/docs/脂肪性肝病诊疗规范化的专家建_2019.pdf

assets.externalization_strategy: Prefer rebuildable vector-store artifacts generated from RAG documents; keep rebuild command, embedding model version, and index checksum.
assets.demo_boundary: Show retrieval metrics and rebuild status, not SQLite internals.
assets.acceptance_rule: Do not delete unless RAG build command and smoke retrieval pass without the existing index.

assets.externalization_strategy: Separate public demo samples from private or bulky upload remnants; keep synthetic demo samples, archive or externalize owner-approved bulky remnants.
assets.demo_boundary: Use synthetic or privacy-safe samples only; never display real personal health uploads.
assets.acceptance_rule: Requires privacy review and owner approval before archive or deletion.

assets.externalization_strategy: Replace local runtime databases with migrations, seed scripts, or sanitized demo DB snapshots when needed.
assets.demo_boundary: Use resettable demo DB or seeded fixtures; avoid exposing user records.
assets.acceptance_rule: Do not delete until migrations and seed path can recreate the expected demo state.

assets.externalization_strategy: Keep thesis source and intentional figures in repository; generated build byproducts may be governed separately only after LaTeX build policy is documented.
assets.demo_boundary: Show compiled thesis sections or selected figures, not temporary LaTeX build files.
assets.acceptance_rule: Do not delete thesis figures or source files without explicit thesis owner approval.
